title: Verify: Tailwind config, PostCSS config and stylesheet tokens unit tests
summary: Unit tests for Tailwind/PostCSS config files and styles.css
description: Write tests from REQ1 acceptance criteria that import the config and read files from disk; no server or browser.
acceptance_criteria: Given the config, when imported, then content globs and token colors match
Given styles.css, when read, then directives, tokens and old rules are present

steps.action: Add test 'config exposes content globs and token colors': import default from ../tailwind.config, assert content toEqual ['./index.html','./src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'] and theme.extend.colors.background toBe 'hsl(var(--background))' and primary.DEFAULT toBe 'hsl(var(--primary))'
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/tailwindConfig.test.ts -t 'config exposes'

steps.action: Import default from ../postcss.config.js and assert Object.keys(plugins) toEqual ['tailwindcss','autoprefixer']
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/tailwindConfig.test.ts -t 'postcss'

steps.action: Read src/styles.css via readFileSync(join(process.cwd(),'src','styles.css')); assert it contains '@tailwind base', '@tailwind components', '@tailwind utilities', '--background:', '--foreground:', '--primary:', '.game-layout' and '.story-panel'
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/tailwindConfig.test.ts -t 'styles.css'
